blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Accurate preoperative subtype classification of renal cell carcinoma (RCC) from contrast-enhanced computed tomography remains clinically challenging. Radiomics provides structured tumour descriptors, whereas foundation representations offer transferable image features. However, it remains unclear whether radiomics still adds value beyond pretrained representations, and how 2D and 3D MedVAE encoders compare in this setting. We compared handcrafted radiomics, 2D MedVAE, 3D MedVAE, and their fusion for binary clear-cell RCC versus non-clear-cell RCC classification on KiTS23 under a unified preprocessing pipeline. Concatenation, cross-attention, and gated fusion were evaluated as representative integration strategies, and radiomics feature importance was analysed to support decision-centric interpretability. Fusion consistently improved discrimination over image-only MedVAE branches. The best overall performance was achieved by 3D gated fusion, with an AUC of 82.7%, outperforming the best 2D fusion model (79.6%), the radiomics baseline (74.4%), and the single-modality MedVAE branches. Ablation analysis further showed clear gains of the full fusion model over both image-only and radiomics-only variants, indicating complementary contributions from radiomics and image representations. These findings suggest that radiomics remains relevant for RCC CT classification in the presence of foundation representations, and that its integration with MedVAE is more effective in the 3D setting. More broadly, the study supports a complementary role for radiomics and foundation representations in clinically meaningful imaging decision support.
blocks.zh: 精确的手术前亚型肾细胞癌分类(RCC)从对比性增强的计算成形图中得出,在临床上仍然具有挑战性。 放射线提供结构化的肿瘤描述符,而基础表示符则提供可转移的图像特征. 然而,目前仍不清楚放射素是否仍然在预先训练过的表示值之外增加价值,以及2D和3D MeDVAE编码器在此环境下的比较情况. 我们比较了手动放射仪,2D MeDVAE,3D MeDVAE及其二元清细胞RCC的聚变与Kits23上的非清细胞RCC分类在统一预处理管下. 结合、交叉关注和门式聚变被评价为具有代表性的融合战略,放射学具有重要性,被分析以支持以决策为中心的可解释性。 融合不断改善对仅以形象为主的MedVAE分支的歧视。 3D门式聚变取得了最佳的整体性能,AUC为82.7%,表现优于最佳2D聚变模型(79.6%),放射基线(74.4%),单式MDVAE分支. 配电分析还显示,完全聚变模式在图像唯一和放射唯一变体方面都有明显收益,表明辐射和图像表现的互补贡献。 这些调查结果表明,放射素在存在基金会表示的情况下仍然与RCC CT分类相关,在3D环境下,它与MDVAE的结合效果更好. 更广泛地说,本研究支持放射学和基础表达在临床有意义的成像决策支持方面发挥补充作用。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Kidney cancer remains a substantial global health burden, with 434,840 new cases and 155,953 deaths reported worldwide in 2022 [ 1 ] . Accurate preoperative characterisation of renal masses, including discrimination between clear cell RCC (ccRCC) and non-clear cell RCC, is clinically important because histologic subtype is associated with prognosis and treatment decisions. Multiphasic contrast-enhanced CT is central to diagnosis and staging and is recommended by the European Association of Urology guideline for RCC [ 2 ] . However, CT interpretation remains limited by inter-reader variability and the difficulty of quantifying subtle intratumoral heterogeneity, motivating computational approaches that can provide reproducible and quantitative decision support.
blocks.zh: 肾癌仍是全球卫生负担沉重,2022年,全世界报告了434,840个新病例,155,953人死亡。 肾脏质团的精确术前特征化,包括清晰细胞RCC(ccRCC)和非清晰细胞RCC之间的区别,在临床上很重要,因为组织亚型与预后和治疗决定有关. 多phasic 对比性增强的CT是诊断和中转的核心,是欧洲泌尿学协会关于RCC[2]的准则推荐的. 然而,CT解释仍然受到阅读者之间的差异和难以量化微妙的道德内异质性的限制,难以激励能够提供可复制和定量决策支持的计算方法.

blocks.en: Radiomics offers a principled way to quantify tumour phenotype from routine imaging. Early work established radiomics as high-throughput extraction of engineered intensity, shape, and texture descriptors and demonstrated associations with cancer phenotype and outcomes [ 3 ] . Subsequent reviews outlined a standardised pipeline spanning image acquisition, segmentation, preprocessing, feature extraction, model development, and validation, while highlighting challenges such as protocol variability and overfitting [ 4 , 5 ] . Reproducibility has been further supported by the Image Biomarker Standardisation Initiative and tools such as PyRadiomics [ 6 , 7 ] . In RCC, CT radiomics has shown promise for distinguishing ccRCC from non-clear cell RCC, supporting its value as a structured and interpretable descriptor of renal tumour phenotype [ 8 ] .
blocks.zh: 放射素为从常规成像中量化肿瘤酚型提供了一个原则性的方法. 早期的工作建立了放射学作为工程强度、形状和纹理描述素的高通量提取,并展示了与癌症酚类和结果的联系[3]。 随后的审查概述了涵盖图像获取、分割、预处理、特征提取、模型开发和验证的标准化管道,同时强调了协议可变性和过度适应[4、5]等挑战。 图像生物标志标准化倡议和PyRadiomics[6,7]等工具进一步支持了可复制性. 在RCC中,CT放射素表现出了将ccRCC与非清晰细胞RCC区分开来的承诺,支持其作为肾脏肿瘤酚类结构化和可解释描述词的价值[8].

blocks.en: Deep learning has also become dominant across medical image analysis tasks [ 9 ] , and end-to-end models have been explored for differentiating renal tumour subtypes on multi-phase CT [ 10 ] . Yet RCC studies often involve limited labelled cohorts and heterogeneous acquisition protocols, making robust representation learning difficult and increasing interest in pretrained representations that can transfer useful visual structure beyond task-specific datasets.
blocks.zh: 深入学习在医学影像分析任务中也占据主导地位[9],并探索了在多相CT[10]上区分肾肿瘤亚型的端到端模型. 然而,RCC的研究往往涉及有限的标签组群和不同的获取协议,使得强大的代表性学习难以进行,并且对经过预先培训的能将有用的视觉结构转移至特定任务数据集以外的表达方式越来越感兴趣。

blocks.en: Within this broader shift, foundation models emphasise large-scale pretraining and downstream adaptability [ 11 ] . In general vision, Vision Transformers, masked autoencoders, and vision-language contrastive models have shown strong transferability at scale [ 12 , 13 , 14 ] . In medical imaging, resources and models such as RadImageNet, Models Genesis, and MedicalNet or Med3D seek to address label scarcity while preserving domain-specific and volumetric structure [ 15 , 16 , 17 ] . More recent developments, including SAM, MedSAM, MedCLIP, and Merlin, further illustrate the rapid growth of large-scale pretrained medical representations [ 18 , 19 , 20 , 21 ] . In this landscape, MedVAE is particularly relevant for RCC CT because it provides large-scale pretrained 2D and 3D variational autoencoders for medical image encoding [ 22 ] . Its emphasis on compact and generalisable latent representations makes it a plausible source of foundation representations for downstream classification when full-resolution learning is costly or data are limited.
blocks.zh: 在这一更广泛的转变中,基础模型强调大规模预训和下游适应性[11]. 在一般视觉中,Visual Transformers,蒙面自动编码器,以及视觉语言对比模型在尺度上表现出了强大的可转移性[12,13,14]. 在医疗成像方面,RadImageNet、Models Genesis和MedicalNet或Med3D等资源和模型力求解决标签稀缺问题,同时保留特定领域和体积结构[15、16、17]。 最近的一些事态发展,包括SAM、MedSAM、MedCLIP和Merlin,进一步说明大规模预先培训的医疗说明[18、19、20、21]的迅速增长。 在这个地貌中,MDVAE对RCC CT特别相关,因为它为医疗图像编码提供了大规模预训的2D和3D变异自编码器[22]. 它强调紧凑和一般的潜在表述,使它成为在全面了解情况费用高昂或数据有限的情况下进行下游分类的基础表述的合理来源。

blocks.en: Despite these advances, three gaps remain for CT-based RCC classification. First, it is unclear whether foundation representations alone are sufficiently discriminative in typical RCC cohort sizes, or whether radiomics still provides complementary information [ 3 , 4 , 22 ] . Second, although RCC CT is inherently volumetric, many pipelines still operate on 2D slices, and the relative advantages of 2D slice-based versus 3D volumetric encoders, as well as their interaction with radiomics, remain insufficiently characterised [ 16 , 17 ] . Third, although fusion may improve performance, it remains underexplored how to obtain clinically meaningful interpretability that reflects the internal decision pathway rather than relying only on post hoc visual explanations.
blocks.zh: 尽管取得了这些进展,在基于氯乙烯的RCC分类方面仍有三个差距。 首先,尚不清楚的是,在典型的RCC组群规模中,单是基础表述是否就足够具有歧视性,或者放射素是否仍然提供补充信息[3,4,22]. 第二,虽然RCC CT本质上是量子化的,但许多管道仍然运行在2D切片上,2D切片对3D量子编码器的相对优势以及它们与放射性的相互作用仍然不够特征化[16,17]. 第三,虽然聚变可以改善性能,但是它仍然没有充分探讨如何获得临床上有意义的解释性,反映内部决定途径,而不是仅仅依靠事后的视觉解释。

blocks.en: To examine radiomics–foundation interaction, we evaluate fusion as a comparative analytical tool. Specifically, we consider feature concatenation as a transparent baseline, cross-attention as a mechanism for modelling conditional dependence, and gated fusion as an established dynamic weighting strategy inspired by prior work on gated feature integration [ 23 , 24 , 25 ] .
blocks.zh: 为了研究放射学-创始互动,我们评价核聚变是一种比较分析工具。 具体地说,我们认为,地貌结合是一个透明的基线,交叉注意是建立有条件依赖性模型的机制,而门化聚变是一种既定的动态加权战略,受到以前门化地貌结合工作的启发[23、24、25]。

blocks.en: Interpretability is a further prerequisite for clinical adoption of medical imaging AI. Many explainability techniques are post hoc, including saliency maps [ 26 ] , Grad-CAM [ 27 ] , Integrated Gradients [ 28 ] , LIME [ 29 ] , and SHAP [ 30 ] . However, such explanations can remain visually plausible while being only weakly tied to learned parameters and may not faithfully reflect model reasoning [ 31 ] . In healthcare, multiple critiques and surveys have argued that current explainability methods can be misaligned with clinical needs and may offer limited patient-level decision support [ 32 , 33 , 34 ] . In high-stakes settings, analysing internal decision processes, or using inherently interpretable approaches, has therefore been argued to be preferable to explaining black boxes after the fact [ 35 , 36 ] . In feature fusion settings, internal contribution analysis offers a practical route to decision-centric interpretability by quantifying how structured radiomics descriptors contribute within the fusion mechanism [ 25 , 24 , 6 ] .
blocks.zh: 可解释性是临床上采用医学成像AI的另一个先决条件. 许多可解释性技术都是事后特制的,包括显式地图[26],Grad-CAM[27],集成梯度[28],LIME[29],SHAP[30]. 然而,这种解释仍可看似合理,但仅与学到的参数有微弱的联系,可能无法忠实地反映模型推理[31]。 在保健方面,多次批评和调查都认为,目前的可解释性方法可能与临床需求不符,可能为患者提供有限的决策支持[32、33、34]。 因此,在高风险环境下,分析内部决策程序,或采用内在可解释的办法,被认为比在事实之后解释黑箱更为可取[35、36]。 在特征聚变设置中,内部贡献分析通过量化结构化的放射素描述器如何在聚变机制内贡献[25,24,6],为决策中心解释提供了一条实用途径.

blocks.en: In this work, we make the following contributions:
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们作出了以下贡献:

blocks.en: • We present a CT-based RCC classification framework that combines MedVAE-derived 2D or 3D representations with handcrafted radiomics features under consistent preprocessing and evaluation. • We compare 2D slice-based and 3D volumetric MedVAE encoders to assess how representation dimensionality affects RCC subtype discrimination. • We evaluate representative fusion mechanisms, including concatenation, cross-attention, and gated fusion, to quantify radiomics–foundation interaction gains and stability. • We assess the added value of radiomics beyond foundation representations and analyse radiomics feature importance within the fusion model to provide decision-centric interpretability.
blocks.zh: • 支助 我们提出了一个基于CT的RCC分类框架,将MDVAE衍生的2D或3D表示法与手动放射学特征相结合,进行一致的预处理和评价。 我们比较2D切片式和3D卷片式的MedVAE编码器,以评估代表维度如何影响RCC亚型歧视. ^ . 我们评价具有代表性的聚变机制,包括凝聚、交叉关注和门式聚变,以量化辐射 — — 建立的互动成果和稳定性。 我们评估辐射在基础表述之外的附加价值,并分析辐射在聚变模型中的重要性,以便提供以决策为中心的解释。

blocks.en: We present a CT-based RCC classification framework that combines MedVAE-derived 2D or 3D representations with handcrafted radiomics features under consistent preprocessing and evaluation.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了一个基于CT的RCC分类框架,将MDVAE衍生的2D或3D表示与手动放射特征结合,进行一致的预处理和评价.

blocks.en: We compare 2D slice-based and 3D volumetric MedVAE encoders to assess how representation dimensionality affects RCC subtype discrimination.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了基于2D切片和3D卷体的MedVAE编码器,以评估代表维度如何影响RCC亚型歧视.

blocks.en: We evaluate representative fusion mechanisms, including concatenation, cross-attention, and gated fusion, to quantify radiomics–foundation interaction gains and stability.
blocks.zh: 我们评价具有代表性的聚变机制,包括凝聚、交叉注意力和门式聚变,以量化放射性-建立互动的成果和稳定性。

blocks.en: We assess the added value of radiomics beyond foundation representations and analyse radiomics feature importance within the fusion model to provide decision-centric interpretability.
blocks.zh: 我们评估辐射在基础表述之外的附加价值,并分析辐射在聚变模型中的重要性,以便提供以决策为中心的解释。

blocks.en: 2 Methods
blocks.zh: 2 方法

blocks.en: Methods overview. Figure 1 summarises the overall study framework. We compare handcrafted CT radiomics with MedVAE-derived foundation representations for RCC subtype classification on KiTS23. Under a unified preprocessing protocol, we extract (i) a structured radiomics vector from a tumour ROI, and (ii) a MedVAE image embedding using either a 2D slice-based pathway or a 3D volumetric pathway. We then evaluate three fusion strategies, concatenation, cross-attention, and gated fusion, and perform fusion-based interpretability analyses by ranking radiomics feature importance within the model decision pathway.
blocks.zh: 方法概述。 图1概述了总体研究框架。 我们比较了手动CT放射素与KitS23上RCC亚型分类的MedVAE衍生基表示. 在统一的预处理协议下,我们提取(一) 从肿瘤ROI中提取结构化放射矢量,(二) 使用2D切片路径或3D卷曲路径嵌入的MDVAE图像。 然后,我们评价三种聚变战略,即凝聚、交叉注意力和门式聚变,并通过放射学的排名来进行聚变的可解释性分析。

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Overview of the radiomics–MedVAE fusion framework. Tumour-centred CT inputs are processed through either a 2D MedVAE branch with top- k k slice selection or a 3D MedVAE branch with volumetric encoding, while handcrafted radiomics features are extracted from the radiomics ROI and reduced through feature selection. The resulting image and radiomics representations are then combined using concatenation, cross-attention, or gated fusion for RCC subtype classification.
blocks.zh: 图1:放射素-MedVAE聚变框架概述. 以肿瘤为中心的CT输入要么通过具有顶-k k切片选择的2D MeDVAE分支处理,要么通过具有体积编码的3D MeDVAE分支处理,同时从放射素ROI中提取手动放射素特征并通过特征选择减小. 由此产生的影像和放射素表现物然后通过凝聚,交叉注意,或门式聚变来组合,用于RCC子类型分类.

blocks.en: 2.1 Dataset and preprocessing
blocks.zh: 2.1 数据集和预处理

blocks.en: We use the KiTS23 cohort, a publicly released challenge dataset of contrast-enhanced preoperative CT scans with semantic segmentations of kidney, tumour, and cyst structures [ 37 , 38 ] . KiTS23 has a heterogeneous contrast setting, with cases acquired in either corticomedullary or nephrogenic phase [ 37 ] . After excluding multifocal cases to avoid label ambiguity and intra-patient lesion heterogeneity, the final cohort used in this study comprised 396 cases.
blocks.zh: 我们使用KitS23组, 一个公开发布的挑战数据集, 对比增强 手术前CT扫描 与语义分解 肾脏,肿瘤,和囊肿结构 [37,38]。 KitS23具有不同的对比环境,在皮革或肾病阶段获得的病例[37]。 在排除多焦点病例以避免标签模糊和患者内部的损伤异质性之后,本研究中使用的最后一组病例为396例。

blocks.en: All CT volumes and segmentation masks are reoriented to a common RAS axis convention and resampled to an isotropic voxel spacing of 1.0 mm using bilinear interpolation for images and nearest-neighbour interpolation for masks. CT intensities are clipped to a fixed Hounsfield Unit range of [-150, 200] prior to downstream processing.
blocks.zh: 所有CT卷和片段口罩均重定向为常见的RAS轴式会议,并采用图像双线插值和口罩近邻插值重模为1.0毫米的异构排距. CT强度在下游加工前被剪切到固定的Hounsfield单元范围[-150,200].

blocks.en: For each case, we compute a tight tumour bounding box from the binary tumour mask. Based on this box, we generate two ROIs: (i) a radiomics ROI using the tumour box without additional margin, and (ii) a deep-learning ROI obtained by expanding the tumour box with a fixed 12-voxel margin to retain limited surrounding context. When the expanded ROI extends beyond the image boundary, padding is handled during subsequent patch construction.
blocks.zh: 每个病例,我们从二元肿瘤面具中计算出一个紧凑的肿瘤约束盒. 基于这个框,我们产生两个ROI:(一)使用肿瘤盒的放射ROI,没有额外的边距;和(二)通过扩大肿瘤盒而获得的深层学习ROI,有固定的12伏xel边距以保留有限的周围环境. 当扩展的ROI扩展到图像边界以外时,在后续的补丁构造中处理补丁.

blocks.en: Using the preprocessed case-level image volume and binary tumour mask, we generate a zero-margin segmentation crop for radiomics and an expanded crop for deep learning. If multiple tumour annotations are available for a case, we use a consensus tumour mask derived using Simultaneous Truth and Performance Level Estimation (STAPLE) together with the corresponding preprocessed case-level imaging volume to ensure geometric consistency [ 39 ] .
blocks.zh: 利用预处理的病例级图像体积和二进制肿瘤面具,我们产生用于放射学的零边距分化作物和用于深层学习的扩大作物. 如果对一个病例有多种肿瘤说明,我们使用一个协商一致的肿瘤面具,利用同步真伪和性能水平估计(STAPLE)以及相应的预处理的病例水平成像量,以确保几何一致性[39].

blocks.en: 2.2 Radiomics feature extraction and normalisation
blocks.zh: 2.2 放射性特征提取和正常化

blocks.en: As illustrated in Fig. 1 , radiomics descriptors are extracted from the radiomics ROI , which is derived from the MONAI-preprocessed CT volumes and masks described above, using PyRadiomics [ 40 , 7 ] . Feature computation follows IBSI-aligned settings to improve reproducibility [ 6 ] . We compute (i) shape features from the Original image type only, and (ii) first-order and texture features from both the Original image and Laplacian-of-Gaussian filtered images with σ ∈ { 1 , 2 , 3 } \sigma\in\{1,2,3\} . This yields an initial radiomics feature vector x RAD ∈ ℝ 386 x_{\mathrm{RAD}}\in\mathbb{R}^{386} .
blocks.zh: 如图1所示,放射素描述器是从放射素ROI中提取的,来源于上述MONAI预处理的CT卷和口罩,使用PyRadiomics[40,7]. 特性计算遵循IBSI对齐设置,以提高可复制性[6]. 我们从原始图像类型中计算出(一) 形状特征,以及(二) 从原始图像和Laplacian-of-Gussian过滤的图像中计算出的第一顺序和纹理特征,这些图像带有\\\ { 1, 2, 3}\ sigma\ in\ 1, 2,3\ 。 这会产生一个初始放射特征向量 x RAD → R 386 x → mathrm{RAD}}\in\ mathbb{R}^{386} 。

blocks.en: Intensity discretisation is performed using a fixed bin width of 25 HU during radiomics extraction. To improve robustness, we adopt a multi-stage feature selection strategy. First, we retain only features with inter-observer reliability ICC ≥ 0.75 \mathrm{ICC}\geq 0.75 . Second, we remove the lowest 20% of features ranked by median absolute deviation. Third, highly correlated feature pairs are pruned using a Pearson correlation threshold of | ρ | > 0.95 |\rho|>0.95 . Finally, hierarchical clustering based on correlation distance is applied with a distance threshold of 0.2, and representative features are retained from each cluster. After this procedure, the selected radiomics vector is denoted by r ~ ∈ ℝ 73 \tilde{r}\in\mathbb{R}^{73} . For fusion-based deep models, r ~ \tilde{r} is z-score standardised using training-set statistics before projection and integration with MedVAE representations. By contrast, the standalone radiomics-based machine-learning baseline uses the selected radiomics features in their extracted form.
blocks.zh: 在放射抽取过程中使用25 HU的固定的bin宽度来进行强度光碟化. 为了提高稳健性,我们采取了多阶段的特色选择战略。 首先,我们只保留观测器间可靠性的特性 ICC 0.75\mathrm{ICC}\geq 0.75 (英语). 其次,我们删除了以绝对偏差中位数排序的最低20%的特性. 第三,高度相关的特征对使用皮尔逊相关阈值为 ^ ^ > 0.95 → rho|>0.95 。 最后,采用基于相关距离的分级分组,距离阈值为0.2,并且保留每个分组的代表性特征. 在此程序之后, 选定的放射向量由 r ~ ~ ~ R 73\ tilde{r}\in\ mathbb{ R}^{73} 表示 。 对于基于聚变的深层模型,r~\tilde{r}在预测和与MDVAE表示法整合之前,使用训练集统计法将z分标准化. 相比之下,独立的基于放射素的机器学习基线则使用其提取形式的选定放射素特征.

blocks.en: 2.3 MedVAE foundation representations
blocks.zh: 2.3 MeDVAE基金会代表

blocks.en: As illustrated in Fig. 1 , we use pretrained MedVAE autoencoders as compact representation extractors for both the 2D and 3D image branches [ 22 ] . We compared frozen, partially fine-tuned, and fully fine-tuned encoder settings, and found partial fine-tuning to perform best. Unless otherwise stated, all reported MedVAE results therefore use the partially fine-tuned configuration, with selected pretrained modules updated jointly with the projection, fusion, and classification components on KiTS23.
blocks.zh: 如图1所示,我们使用预先训练的MDVAE自动编码器作为2D和3D图像分支的紧凑表示提取器[22]. 我们比较了冷冻,部分微调, 和完全微调的编码器设置, 并发现部分微调 表现最好。 因此,除非另有说明,所有报告的MDVAE结果都采用了部分微调的配置,选定的预训模块与KitS23上的投影、聚变和分类组件一起更新。

blocks.en: Given an input x x , the VAE encoder maps the image to a latent representation [ 41 ] . In practice, we use the latent tensor returned by the MedVAE forward pass. When the returned object provides a distribution-like mean, we use that mean as the image representation. The resulting latent tensor is then flattened and projected into a 512-dimensional shared embedding space.
blocks.zh: 在输入 x x 时, VAE 编码器将图像映射为潜在表示 [41] 。 在实际操作中,我们使用MDVAE前传返回的潜伏抗震器. 当返回对象提供类似分布的平均值时,我们使用这个平均值作为图像表示. 由此产生的潜伏抗震器被平整并投射到512维共享嵌入空间.

blocks.en: 2D MedVAE pathway: slice selection and pooling
blocks.zh: 2D MeDVAE 路径: 切片选择和集合

blocks.en: For the 2D branch shown in Fig. 1 , we use the deep-learning ROI after padding and centre-cropping to a fixed spatial size of 128 × 128 × 128 128\times 128\times 128 , yielding a single-case input tensor P 2 ​ D ∈ ℝ 1 × 128 × 128 × 128 P_{2D}\in\mathbb{R}^{1\times 128\times 128\times 128} . Axial slices are then ranked according to tumour extent in the mask, measured as the number of tumour-positive pixels in each slice. We retain the top- k k tumour-bearing slices with the largest tumour area and restore them to ascending axial order before encoding. Each selected slice is encoded by the pretrained 2D MedVAE encoder. The resulting slice-level latent tensor is flattened and projected to a 512-dimensional embedding, u i ∈ ℝ 512 . u_{i}\in\mathbb{R}^{512}. (1) Slice embeddings are then aggregated into a case-level image representation f img ∈ ℝ 512 f_{\mathrm{img}}\in\mathbb{R}^{512} .
For the 2D branch, we adopt partial fine-tuning by freezing most pretrained MedVAE parameters and allowing only a subset of later pretrained modules to update during downstream training.
blocks.zh: 对于2D分支,我们采用部分微调,冻结了大多数经过预先训练的MDVAE参数,并且只允许在下游训练时对后来经过预先训练的模块进行子集更新.

blocks.en: 3D MedVAE pathway: tumour-centred volumetric patch
blocks.zh: 3D MeDVAE路径:以肿瘤为中心的体积补丁

blocks.en: For the 3D branch shown in Fig. 1 , we use one tumour-centred volumetric crop per case. The expanded deep-learning ROI is padded and centre-cropped to a fixed size of 96 × 96 × 96 96\times 96\times 96 , yielding an input tensor P 3 ​ D ∈ ℝ 1 × 96 × 96 × 96 P_{3D}\in\mathbb{R}^{1\times 96\times 96\times 96} . This patch is passed through the pretrained 3D MedVAE encoder, the returned latent tensor is flattened, and a learned linear projection maps it to a 512-dimensional image embedding f img ∈ ℝ 512 f_{\mathrm{img}}\in\mathbb{R}^{512} . For the 3D branch, we adopt the same partial fine-tuning policy used in the 2D branch, freezing most pretrained MedVAE parameters and allowing only a subset of later pretrained modules to update during downstream training. The code also supports frozen and fully fine-tuned settings.
blocks.zh: 对于图1显示的3D分支,我们每例使用一个以肿瘤为中心的体积作物. 扩大的深度学习ROI是加成的,中央缩放的固定尺寸为96×96×96×96×96×96×96×96×96×96×96×96×96×96×96×96×96×的输入式呼号,生成一个输入式呼号P 3 D×R 1×96×96×96×96×96×96×96×96×96×96×96×96×96×96×96×96×96×96×96×96×96××96×96××96×96×96××96××96××96××96×××××××××××××××××3×××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××× 96] (英语). 此补丁通过预训的3D MeDVAE编码器传递,返回的潜伏伸缩器被平整,一个学习的线性投影图将其映射到嵌入 f img 的 512 im_{\ mathrm{img}}\in\mathb{R}^{512}的 512 维图像上. 对于3D分支,我们采用了在2D分支中使用的相同的部分微调政策,冻结了最经过预先训练的MDVAE参数,并且只允许在下游训练时更新一个后来经过预先训练的模块的子集. 代码还支持冷冻和完全微调的设置.

blocks.en: 2.4 Fusion models
blocks.zh: 2.4 组合模型

Before fusion, radiomics features are projected into the same shared embedding space: h rad = W rad ​ r ~ + b rad , W rad ∈ ℝ 512 × 73 . h_{\mathrm{rad}}=W_{\mathrm{rad}}\tilde{r}+b_{\mathrm{rad}},\quad W_{\mathrm{rad}}\in\mathbb{R}^{512\times 73}. (2)

blocks.en: Concatenation
blocks.zh: 协和

blocks.en: Concatenation directly combines the image embedding and projected radiomics embedding: h fuse = [ f img ; h rad ] , h_{\mathrm{fuse}}=[f_{\mathrm{img}};h_{\mathrm{rad}}], (3) which is then passed to the classifier head for prediction.
blocks.zh: 聚合直接结合了图像嵌入和投射放射线嵌入: h 引信 = [f img; h rad], h_{\ mathrm{fuse}}= [f_{\ mathrm{img}};h_{\ mathrm{rad}}], (3)然后传递到分类头进行预测.

blocks.en: Cross-attention fusion
blocks.zh: 双向聚变

blocks.en: The implemented cross-attention mechanism uses image token(s) as queries and radiomics tokens as keys and values. Radiomics features are first projected into a shared embedding and then transformed into a small set of learned radiomics tokens.
blocks.zh: 已实施的交叉注意机制使用图像符号作为查询,放射符号作为键和值. 放射特征首先被投射为共享嵌入,然后转化为一小组学习的放射符号.

blocks.en: For the 2D branch, let U ∈ ℝ k × 512 U\in\mathbb{R}^{k\times 512} denote the slice-level image embeddings before pooling, and let h rad ∈ ℝ 512 h_{\mathrm{rad}}\in\mathbb{R}^{512} denote the projected radiomics embedding. We form image queries and radiomics tokens as Q \displaystyle Q = U ​ W Q , \displaystyle=UW_{Q}, (4) R \displaystyle R = reshape ⁡ ( h rad ​ W R ) , \displaystyle=\mathrm{reshape}(h_{\mathrm{rad}}W_{R}), (5) where Q ∈ ℝ k × d c Q\in\mathbb{R}^{k\times d_{c}} and R ∈ ℝ T × d c R\in\mathbb{R}^{T\times d_{c}} . Cross-attention is then computed as Attn ⁡ ( Q , R , R ) = softmax ⁡ ( Q ​ R ⊤ d c ) ​ R . \mathrm{Attn}(Q,R,R)=\mathrm{softmax}\!\left(\frac{QR^{\top}}{\sqrt{d_{c}}}\right)R. (6) Residual connections, layer normalisation, and a feed-forward block are applied, after which the attended slice tokens are mean-pooled and concatenated with the pooled image embedding for classification.

Let q img ∈ ℝ 1 × d c q_{\mathrm{img}}\in\mathbb{R}^{1\times d_{c}} denote the projected volumetric query token and let R ∈ ℝ T × d c R\in\mathbb{R}^{T\times d_{c}} denote the radiomics tokens. Cross-attention is applied in the same form: Attn ⁡ ( q img , R , R ) = softmax ⁡ ( q img ​ R ⊤ d c ) ​ R . \mathrm{Attn}(q_{\mathrm{img}},R,R)=\mathrm{softmax}\!\left(\frac{q_{\mathrm{img}}R^{\top}}{\sqrt{d_{c}}}\right)R. (7) The attended output is then fused with the image embedding for final classification.

(7) 将所参与的输出与图像嵌入结合,以便进行最后分类。

blocks.en: Gated fusion
blocks.zh: 核聚变

blocks.en: We implement channel-wise dynamic weighting inspired by prior work on gated feature integration [ 24 ] . In the implemented formulation, the gate is generated from the radiomics projection alone: g = σ ⁡ ( MLP ⁡ ( h rad ) ) , g ∈ ( 0 , 1 ) 512 , g=\sigma\!\left(\mathrm{MLP}(h_{\mathrm{rad}})\right),\quad g\in(0,1)^{512}, (8) where a multilayer perceptron (MLP) uses a hidden layer of dimension 256 with ReLU activation, followed by a sigmoid output layer. The fused embedding is then h fuse = g ⊙ f img + ( 1 − g ) ⊙ h rad . h_{\mathrm{fuse}}=g\odot f_{\mathrm{img}}+(1-g)\odot h_{\mathrm{rad}}. (9) This formulation yields an explicit channel-wise balance between image-derived and radiomics-derived evidence.
blocks.zh: 我们实施频道动态加权,灵感来源于以前关于门面特征整合的工作[24]. 在已执行的配方中,闸口单独由放射投影产生: g = σ σ(MLP ⁡ (h rad ))), g ∈ (0, 1) 512, g =\ sigma\!\left(\mathrm{MLP}(h_{\ mathrm{rad}})\right),\quad g\in(0,1) ^{ 512}, (8) 一个多层受体(MLP) 使用带有ReLU激活的隐藏维度256的层,然后是sigmoid输出层. 引信的嵌入是 h 引信 = g = f img + (1 - g) +  h h rad 。 h_{\mathrm{fuse}}=g\odot f_{\mathrm{img}}+(1-g)\odot h_{\mathrm{rad}}〕. (9) 这种提法在图像生成的证据和辐射生成的证据之间有明确的通道平衡。

blocks.en: 2.5 Fusion-based interpretability analysis
blocks.zh: 2.5 基于融合的解释性分析

blocks.en: Post hoc saliency methods can be visually appealing but may be weakly coupled to the actual decision parameters of the trained model and can therefore be misleading in high-stakes settings [ 31 , 32 , 33 , 34 , 35 ] . We therefore focus on decision-centric interpretability by analysing radiomics contributions inside the fusion model.
blocks.zh: 事后的突出性方法可以具有视觉吸引力,但可能与训练有素模型的实际决定参数结合得微弱,因此在高考环境中可能误导[31、32、33、34、35]。 因此,我们通过分析核聚变模式内的放射性贡献,注重以决策为中心的可解释性。

blocks.en: To quantify feature contribution, we compute permutation feature importance by randomly permuting one radiomics feature across cases in the evaluation split and measuring the resulting decrease in AUC. In the provided implementation, the permutation procedure is repeated R = 5 R=5 times per feature, and the mean AUC drop is used for ranking.
blocks.zh: 为了量化对特征的贡献,我们通过在评估中分解并衡量由此造成的AUC减少量,随机地将一个放射性特征渗透到各个病例中,从而计算出其重要性。 在所提供的执行中,穿梭程序重复R=每个特性的5R=5次,平均AUC降级用于排名.

blocks.en: 3 Experiments and Results
blocks.zh: 3 实验和结果

blocks.en: 3.1 Experimental setup
blocks.zh: 3.1 实验装置

blocks.en: We optimise weighted cross-entropy loss for binary classification, where class weights are computed from the training split to mitigate label imbalance.
blocks.zh: 我们优化了二进制分类的加权交叉损失,从培训分拆中计算班次权重,以减轻标签不平衡。

blocks.en: Both 2D and 3D implementations use Adam. In the 2D branch, all trainable parameters use a learning rate of 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} . In the 3D branch, the partially fine-tuned MedVAE backbone uses a learning rate of 1 × 10 − 5 1\times 10^{-5} , whereas newly added heads use 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} , with weight decay 1 × 10 − 5 1\times 10^{-5} . Training uses a ReduceLROnPlateau scheduler with factor 0.5 and patience 5, and early stopping based on validation AUC with patience 15.
blocks.zh: 2D和3D两个执行都使用亚当. 在2D分支中,所有可训练参数使用1×10−4 1\times 10×4}的学习率. 在3D分支中,部分微调的MedVAE骨干采用1×10−5 1\times 10×5}的学习率,而新加入的头使用1×10−4 1\times 10×4},体重衰减1×10×5 1\times 10×5}. 训练使用带有系数0.5和耐心5的LindLROnPlateau调度器,并以耐心15的AUC验证为基础提前停止.

blocks.en: Augmentations are applied only to the deep-learning branch. Training-time augmentation includes random flips, random 90-degree rotations, and small affine perturbations, whereas validation and test inputs are processed deterministically. We perform stratified case-level splitting to avoid information leakage, using fixed proportions of 60% for training, 25% for validation, and 15% for testing.
blocks.zh: 增益仅适用于深层学习分支. 训练时间的增强包括随机翻转,随机90度旋转,以及小的近缘扰动,而验证和测试输入则经过决定性的处理. 我们进行分级的个案分类,以避免信息泄露,使用60%的固定比例用于培训,25%用于验证,15%用于测试。

blocks.en: The primary metric is the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC). We additionally report accuracy, F1-score, precision, recall (sensitivity), and specificity. Model selection is based on validation AUC. For threshold-dependent metrics, the final operating point is selected on the validation set using Youden’s J J statistic and then applied unchanged to the held-out test set [ 42 ] .
blocks.zh: 主要衡量标准是接收器操作特征曲线(AUC)下的区域. 我们还报告准确性、F1-分数、准确性、回忆(敏感性)和具体性。 模型选择基于验证的AUC. 对于依赖阈值的度量衡,最后的操作点是在使用Youden的J J统计的验证集中选择的,然后在搁置测试集中保持不变地应用[42].

blocks.en: 3.2 Overall performance comparison
blocks.zh: 3.2 国家 总体业绩比较

blocks.en: Table 1 : Performance comparison of radiomics, single-modality MedVAE, and fusion models for binary ccRCC versus non-ccRCC classification. The best result in each column is shown in bold. All metrics are reported in %.
blocks.zh: 表1:放射素,单式MDVAE,二进制CCRCC分类与非CCRCC分类的聚变模型的性能比较. 每栏的最佳成绩以粗体显示。 所有衡量标准都以百分比报告。

blocks.en: Table 1 summarises the performance of radiomics, single-modality MedVAE, and fusion-based models for binary ccRCC versus non-ccRCC classification. Among all evaluated models, the 3D gated fusion model achieved the highest AUC of 82.7%, indicating that joint modelling of volumetric MedVAE representations and handcrafted radiomics provided the strongest overall discrimination. The best 2D fusion model, also based on gated fusion, reached an AUC of 79.6%, outperforming both the 2D-only model and the radiomics baseline.
blocks.zh: 表1概括了放射素,单模式的MDVAE的性能,以及二进制CCRCC与非CCRCC分类的聚变模型. 在所有被评价的模型中,3D门式聚变模型达到了82.7%的最高AUC,表明对体积MDVAE表示和手动放射物的联合建模提供了最强烈的整体区别. 最好的2D核聚变模型,同样基于门式核聚变,达到了79.6%的AUC,优于2D型模式和放射线基线.

blocks.en: Fusion improved performance consistently over single-modality image models. In the 2D setting, AUC increased from 59.5% for the image-only branch to 74.7%, 77.1%, and 79.6% for concatenation, cross-attention, and gated fusion, respectively. A similar pattern was observed for the 3D branch, where the image-only model achieved an AUC of 63.2%, while the corresponding fusion variants reached 73.8%, 79.5%, and 82.7%. These results suggest that radiomics provided complementary information that was not fully captured by MedVAE image representations alone.
blocks.zh: 组合比单一模式图像模型不断提高性能。 在2D设置中,AUC从仅用于图像分支的59.5%分别增加到74.7%,77.1%和79.6%用于调制,交叉调制和门式聚变. 3D分支也观察到类似模式,仅图像模型实现63.2%的AUC,而相应的聚变体达到73.8%,79.5%,82.7%. 这些结果表明,放射学提供了补充信息,而光是MDVAE图像显示并不能完全掌握这些信息。

blocks.en: Comparing fusion strategies, gated fusion yielded the strongest AUC in both the 2D and 3D settings. This trend suggests that adaptive channel-wise weighting offered a more effective integration mechanism than either simple concatenation or the current cross-attention formulation. Notably, the 3D gated fusion model also achieved competitive precision (85.7%) and specificity (72.2%), while maintaining balanced recall (71.4%), indicating that its gain in AUC was not achieved through a highly skewed operating point.
blocks.zh: 相比聚变策略,门式聚变在2D和3D两种设置中都产生了最强的AUC. 这一趋势表明,适应性通道权重比简单的结合或目前的交叉意向式配方提供了更有效的整合机制。 值得注意的是,3D门式聚变模型也实现了竞争精度(85.7%)和特异性(72.2%),同时保持平衡召回(71.4%),表明它在AUC中的收益不是通过高度扭曲的操作点实现的。

blocks.en: The radiomics baseline remained competitive relative to single-modality image branches. The ML baseline achieved an AUC of 74.4%, exceeding both the 2D-only and 3D-only MedVAE branches. This finding is consistent with the view that handcrafted radiomics remains a strong and stable descriptor family in relatively small RCC cohorts with heterogeneous acquisition conditions. However, the best fusion models outperformed the radiomics baseline, indicating that radiomics and MedVAE features were complementary rather than redundant.
blocks.zh: 与单一模式图像分支相比,放射性基线仍然具有竞争力。 ML基线达到74.4%的AUC,超过了2D型和3D型的MDVAE分支. 这一结论符合以下观点,即手动放射菌在拥有不同获取条件的较小RCC组群中仍然是一个强大和稳定的描述家族。 然而,最好的聚变模型的性能超过了放射素基线,表明放射素和MDVAE特征是互补的而不是多余的.

blocks.en: 3.3 Ablation analysis
blocks.zh: 3.3 离散分析

blocks.en: Table 2 : Ablation analysis of the best-performing 3D gated fusion model. AUC is reported on the test set. The full fusion model is compared against image-only and radiomics-only variants using the same evaluation protocol.
blocks.zh: 表2 最佳3D门式聚变模型的放大分析. AUC在测试集上报告. 将全聚变模型与使用同一评价协议的仅图像和仅放射变体进行比较。

blocks.en: To further evaluate modality complementarity, we analysed the best-performing configuration using single-modality ablations. As shown in Table 2 , the full 3D gated fusion model achieved an AUC of 82.7%, whereas the image-only and radiomics-only variants reached 60.4% and 52.9%, respectively. These values were obtained from the exported ablation results of the final model.
blocks.zh: 为了进一步评价模式的互补性,我们用单一模式模拟法分析了最佳配置。 如表2所示,完整的3D门式聚变模型实现82.7%的AUC,而只有图像和放射的变体分别达到60.4%和52.9%。 这些数值来自最后模型的出口减值结果。

blocks.en: The large drop in AUC observed after removing either branch indicates that the performance of the final model cannot be explained by one modality alone. Instead, the gain from 60.4% or 52.9% to 82.7% supports the interpretation that the learned interaction between radiomics and image representations was itself beneficial. In this setting, the image-only ablation outperformed the radiomics-only ablation, suggesting that the volumetric MedVAE branch provided the stronger standalone signal within the best 3D fusion configuration, while radiomics supplied additional structured information that substantially improved discrimination when fused.
blocks.zh: AUC在移除两个分支后观察到的大幅下降表明,最终模型的性能不能仅用一种模式来解释。 相反,从60.4%或52.9%到82.7%的收益支持人们的解释,即放射学和图像表现之间的学习互动本身是有益的。 在此设定中,只图像的衰减效果超过了只辐射的衰减效果,说明体积MDVAE分支在最佳的3D聚变配置中提供了更强大的独立信号,而放射波则提供了额外的结构化信息,极大地改善了引信时的歧视.

blocks.en: 3.4 Fusion-based interpretability results
blocks.zh: 3.4 基于组合的可解释性结果

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Top 10 radiomics features ranked by permutation importance for the best-performing 3D gated fusion model. Features are ordered by the mean decrease in AUC after feature-wise permutation on the evaluation set. Error bars indicate the standard deviation across repeated permutations.
blocks.zh: 图2:排行榜前十名的放射特征,按照表现最佳的3D门式聚变模型的演化重要性排名. 特征由AUC在对评价集进行特征化演化后的平均下降来排序. 错误栏显示重复排列的标准偏差。

blocks.en: To examine how radiomics contributed within the fusion model, we analysed permutation-based feature importance for the best-performing 3D gated fusion configuration. Figure 2 presents the top 10 radiomics features ranked by the mean decrease in AUC after feature-wise permutation. The most influential feature was original_gldm_DependenceEntropy , while other highly ranked features came from GLCM, GLSZM, and first-order families, many of which were derived from Laplacian-of-Gaussian filtered images. These rankings were used to characterise which structured radiomics descriptors contributed most strongly within the fusion model.
blocks.zh: 为了研究放射素如何在聚变模型中发挥作用,我们分析了基于穿透的特性对最佳的3D门式聚变配置的重要性。 图2显示排行榜前十名的放射特征,其排列顺序为AUC在特征偏移后的平均减少。 最有影响力的功能是原创_gldm_Dependence Entropy ,而其他高排名的功能则来自GLCM,GLSZM,以及一阶家族,其中许多来源于Gausian的Laplacian过滤图像. 这些排名用来描述结构化的放射素描述器在聚变模型中的贡献最大。

blocks.en: Several qualitative patterns emerged from this ranking. First, many of the highest-ranked features belonged to texture families such as GLDM, GLCM, GLSZM, and GLRLM, suggesting that intratumoural heterogeneity remained a key discriminative factor in the fused model. Second, multiple top-ranked features were derived from Laplacian-of-Gaussian filtered images rather than from the original image alone, indicating that multi-scale filtered radiomics contributed useful information beyond simple first-order intensity summaries. Third, both texture and first-order statistics appeared among the most important features, suggesting that the final predictor relied on a combination of heterogeneity-related and distribution-related tumour descriptors.
blocks.zh: 从这一排名中出现了若干定性模式。 首先,许多排位最高的特征都属于纹理家族,如GLDM,GLCM,GLSZM,以及GLRLM,这表明肿瘤内异质性在被熔化模型中仍然是一个关键的区别因素. 其二,多个顶级特征来源于Laplacian-of-Gausian过滤图像,而不是仅从原始图像中推导出来,表明多级滤波辐射在简单的一阶强度摘要之外贡献了有用的信息. 第三,纹理和第一顺序统计都出现在最重要的特征中,表明最终预测器依赖于异质性相关和分布相关肿瘤描述符的组合.

blocks.en: This analysis supports the interpretability framing adopted in this study. Rather than relying exclusively on post hoc saliency visualisation, the fusion model permits direct examination of how structured radiomics descriptors participate in prediction. In this sense, feature-importance ranking provides a decision-centric view of the internal fusion mechanism, highlighting which radiomics characteristics most strongly influenced the final classifier output.
blocks.zh: 这一分析支持本研究采用的可解释性框架。 核聚变模型不完全依靠事后显像,而是允许直接检查结构化放射素描述器如何参与预测。 在这个意义上,特征-重要性排名为内部聚变机制提供了一个以决定为中心的视角,突出了哪些放射特征对最终的分类器输出影响最大.

blocks.en: 4 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: This study shows that radiomics remains valuable for RCC subtype classification even when MedVAE-derived foundation representations are available. Although the detailed performance comparisons are reported in the Results section, the overall pattern was consistent: integrating radiomics with pretrained image representations was more effective than relying on either branch alone. This supports the view that radiomics and foundation representations provide complementary rather than competing information in limited-data renal CT analysis.
blocks.zh: 这项研究表明,即使在有MDVAE衍生的基态表示的情况下,放射性物质仍然对RCC亚型分类很有价值. 虽然成果部分报告了详细的绩效比较,但总体模式是一致的:将放射线与预先训练过的图像表达方式相结合比仅依靠两个分支更有效。 这支持以下观点,即放射和基础表述在有限数据肾脏CT分析中提供了互补而不是相互竞争的信息.

blocks.en: The stronger performance of the 3D models further suggests that preserving volumetric structure is important for this task. RCC phenotype is inherently three-dimensional, and subtype-related heterogeneity is distributed across the tumour volume rather than confined to a small number of axial slices. In this setting, the 3D branch appears better aligned with the underlying anatomy, whereas the 2D branch necessarily compresses volumetric information through slice selection and pooling.
blocks.zh: 3D模型的更强性能进一步表明,保存体积结构对这项任务很重要. RCC酚型本质上是三维的,亚型相关的异质分布在肿瘤体积中,而不是局限于少数轴切片. 在此设置中,3D分支看起来更符合基础解剖学,而2D分支则必然通过切片选择和集合来压缩体积信息.

blocks.en: A particularly important aspect of this study is interpretability. Rather than relying only on post hoc saliency visualisation, we examined radiomics contribution within the fusion model itself. Because radiomics features correspond to defined intensity and texture descriptors, their ranking provides a more structured and clinically meaningful view of model behaviour [ 31 , 35 , 32 , 33 , 34 ] . In practice, this helps connect model predictions to tumour characteristics that are more interpretable than abstract latent features alone. Such a decision-centric perspective may be particularly valuable in preoperative decision support, where clinicians need not only a prediction, but also some indication of which tumour properties are influencing it.
blocks.zh: 这项研究的一个特别重要的方面是可解释性。 我们不是仅仅依靠事后的显像,而是研究了核聚变模式本身内的放射素贡献。 由于放射性特征与定义的强度和纹理描述符相对应,其排名为模型行为提供了更有条理和临床意义的观点[31,35,32,33,34]. 在实践中,这有助于将模型预测与肿瘤特征联系起来,这些特征比仅抽象的潜在特征更能解释. 这种以决策为中心的观点在手术前决策支持中可能特别有价值,临床医生不仅需要预测,而且还需要表明哪些肿瘤特性正在影响它。

blocks.en: This interpretability advantage may also be relevant beyond RCC, as similar fusion designs could support other medical imaging tasks that require both strong discrimination and clinically communicable model behaviour.
blocks.zh: 这种可解释性优势也可能在RCC之外相关,因为类似的聚变设计可以支持其他医学成像任务,这些任务既需要强烈的歧视,又需要临床交流模式行为.

blocks.en: Overall, these findings support a complementary role for radiomics in the foundation-model era. For RCC CT classification, the best results were obtained when MedVAE-derived image features were fused with radiomics, especially in the 3D setting. More broadly, fusion with structured radiomics may offer a practical route toward clinically useful medical AI that balances predictive performance with more interpretable decision support.
blocks.zh: 总的来说,这些调查结果支持在奠基时代发挥放射学的补充作用。 对于RCC CT分类,当MDVAE衍生的图像特性与放射素结合时,特别是3D设定时,获得了最佳结果. 更广义地说,与结构化的放射体结合可能为临床有用的医学AI提供一条实用的路径,在预测性能与更可解释的决定支持之间取得平衡.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: In this study, we investigated the interaction between handcrafted radiomics and MedVAE-derived foundation representations for RCC subtype classification from contrast-enhanced CT. The results show that radiomics remains clinically relevant even in the presence of pretrained image representations, and that the strongest performance is achieved when the two are fused rather than used in isolation. The best overall model was obtained in the 3D setting, supporting the value of preserving volumetric tumour structure for RCC characterisation.
blocks.zh: 在这项研究中,我们调查了人工制成的放射素与由MDVAE衍生的RCC亚型分类基态从对比增强的CT之间的相互作用. 结果显示,放射素即使在有经过预先训练的图像表现物的情况下仍然与临床相关,最强的性能是在两者被引信而不是单独使用时实现的. 在3D设定中获得了最好的整体模型,支持为RCC特征化保留体积肿瘤结构的价值.

blocks.en: Beyond predictive performance, the proposed framework also provides a more structured route to interpretability by identifying which radiomics descriptors contribute within the fusion model. This is clinically important because preoperative subtype classification requires not only accurate discrimination, but also outputs that can be related to recognisable tumour characteristics. More broadly, the same fusion paradigm may be transferable to other medical imaging tasks in which pretrained image representations can be complemented by structured radiomics to improve both performance and interpretability.
blocks.zh: 除了预测性能外,拟议的框架还通过确定核聚变模型中哪些放射素描述器的贡献,为可解释性提供了一个更有条理的路径。 这在临床上很重要,因为手术前的亚型分类不仅需要准确的区分,而且需要与可识别的肿瘤特征相关的输出. 更广泛地说,同样的聚变范式可以转用于其他医学成像任务,在这些任务中,经过预先训练的图像表示可以辅以结构化的放射线,以提高性能和可解释性.
